preconditions.description: The number of brains n is between 2 and 200000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 parent identifiers corresponding to brains 2 through n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p < k for k, p in enumerate(parents, start=2))
preconditions.description: Each parent identifier p_k for brain k is a valid existing brain number strictly less than k.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n-1 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output_values[k-2] == max(dist(1, v, k) for v in range(1, k+1)) for k in range(2, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each stage k (from 2 to n), the k-th output value (index k-2) equals the diameter of the tree formed by brains 1 to k, where dist(u, v, k) is the number of edges on the unique path between u and v in the tree containing nodes 1..k and edges defined by parents up to k.
